bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Gutshiva may use Ruin actions and has 4 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If Gutshiva is Engaged at the start of his Turn, he gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

bonuses.name: Kombi-Rokkit
bonuses.text: Gutshiva can Multi Attack with his Slugga and Rokkit Launcher. If he does,he makes his Attack Test with an additional +1 DV penalty.

bonuses.name: Sneaky Gitz
bonuses.text: During the first round of combat in which Boss Gutshiva ambushes their opponent, they may use their Stealth dice pool of 8 for any Test.

abilities.name: Attack Squig
abilities.text: An Attack Squig can attack on each of Boss Gutshiva's Turns as a Simple Action using the following profile: Squig Bite: 5 +3 ED / AP −1 / Range 1 / Brutal

abilities.name: I'm Da Boss!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. All allies with the ORK Keyword within 10 metres gain +2 bonus dice to Weapon Skill (I) Tests.

abilities.name: Orks Is Never Defeated
abilities.text: Whenever a Threat with the ORK Keyword dies within 10 metres of the Gutshiva, he may sacrifice 1 Shock. If he does, the ORK Threat may make an immediate attack before it dies.
